implementation_detail: APB write decode programs mem[i_paddr] from i_pwdata, clocked no reset
implementation_detail_verbatim: `write_enb = i_psel & i_penable & i_pwrite` → `mem[i_paddr] <= i_pwdata` (clocked, **no reset** on this block — faithful to the reference)
reset_behavior: NOT reset by `i_rstn`; clocked-only, retains last value

implementation_detail: APB read returns result-FIFO o_data combinationally, else 0; advances rd ptr
implementation_detail_verbatim: `read_enb  = i_psel & i_penable & !i_pwrite` → `o_prdata = fifo_result.o_data` (combinational); otherwise `o_prdata = 0`. The result FIFO read pointer advances on `read_enb` (`fifo_result.i_rd = read_enb`).
reference_rule: read_enb=1 → o_prdata==fifo_result.o_data & i_rd advances rd_addr; read_enb=0 → o_prdata==0
reset_behavior: regfile block no reset; result-FIFO rd_addr=0 on async reset

implementation_detail: APB address map selects weight register
4-bit counter: async reset 0, increments while start, resets when start low
implementation_detail_verbatim: `counter` (4-bit): async reset → 0; while `start` asserted, increments each clock; when `start` deasserted, resets to 0
reset_behavior: `counter` cleared to 0 on async active-low reset (`negedge i_rstn`)

implementation_detail: Input-FIFO pop enable active for first two counts while start
implementation_detail_verbatim: `fifo_en = start & (counter < 2)` (drives `i_rd` of both input FIFOs — pops two elements at the start of a pass)
reset_behavior: counter=0 on async reset → fifo_en follows start gate

implementation_detail: Result-FIFO write enable active for counts 2..5

implementation_detail_verbatim: `result_fifo_i_data = out1` when `counter ∈ {2,4}`, `= out2` when `counter ∈ {3,5}`, else `0`, where `out1 = mac_10.o_result` and `out2 = mac_11.o_result`

implementation_detail: Const seed and result chain feeding the result mux (top-row zero seed)
Re-assert start re-runs pass; start deasserted mid-pass resets counter no done
implementation_detail_verbatim: `counter` (4-bit): async reset → 0; while `start` asserted, increments each clock; when `start` deasserted, resets to 0; `done = (counter >= 5)`
reference_rule: re-assert start → counter 0→5, done rises again; drop start mid-pass → counter→0, done==0
reset_behavior: `counter`=0 on async reset (and on start deassert)
